correctness.rationale: For any a>0, c=|<u,v>| in [0,1], reduce the spatial radius to span{u,v}; a component orthogonal to it lowers the squared functional by r^4. For 0<c<1, strict phase alignment gives F(z)=a²((c+s z)²+a²)/(1+z²)², s²=1-c², derivative 2a² G(z)/(1+z²)^3, G=sc+(1-3c²-2a²)z-3sc z²-s²z³. Since G(0)>0, G=-6sc-6s²z<0 and G→-infinity, it has one positive simple zero, the unique global maximizing ray; z=∞ contributes zero. Direct endpoint differentiation at c=0 gives a²=1/2 circle/singleton transition, c=1 a unique projection ray. Singular scaling at a²=1/2 yields z~c^(1/3), dw=1/2+(3/4)c^(4/3)+o(c^(4/3)); below/above critical norm the roots tend to sqrt(1-2a²) / scale c/(2a²-1). Independently rederived symbolic derivative for general parameters and exact rational witness (c,s,a²,z)=(3/5,4/5,18/25,1/4), dw²=9216/10625. Finite algebra is corroborative; analytic proof handles all Hilbert dimensions at least 2.
